title: The Green Guest Book  (O livro de visitas verde)

segments.t: Na mesa ensolarada do canto, Evelyn coloca seus óculos de leitura ao lado de Hannah e Arthur e abre o livro de registros verde com capa de tecido, no mês de maio de trinta anos atrás. Vamos ouvir primeiro.
Look how neat every page is: date, room number, guest name, and weather.
Turn to May tenth, Evelyn—the Friday written on our postcard!
Here it is! 'Heavy rain all night; water dripped onto the sunroom piano.'
Read the next line: 'Moved the piano to the dry corner; middle key swollen shut.'
Oh! That rainy night broke the roof and jammed middle D at the same time!
Look at my aunt's note underneath: 'Locked Room Nine until the roof is dry.'
And she tucked her unfinished waltz inside the lid to wait for sunny weather!
Then summer guests filled the house, years passed, and the bookcase went up.
She never got to hear the second half of her Friday waltz.
Arthur, with your permission, may I write the missing sixteen bars for Wednesday?
You would finish my aunt's song for our reopening, Evelyn?!
In the very same key, with her opening melody leading us home.
Agora vamos revisar linha por linha com a tradução em português.
Look how neat every page is: date, room number, guest name, and weather.
'Olhem como cada página é organizada: data, número do quarto, nome do hóspede e o clima.'
Turn to May tenth, Evelyn—the Friday written on our postcard!
'Vire para o dia dez de maio, Evelyn — a sexta-feira escrita no nosso cartão-postal!'
Here it is! 'Heavy rain all night; water dripped onto the sunroom piano.'
'Aqui está! "Chuva forte a noite toda; a água pingou no piano da varanda coberta."'
Read the next line: 'Moved the piano to the dry corner; middle key swollen shut.'
'Leia a próxima linha: "Movemos o piano para o canto seco; tecla do meio inchada e travada."'
Oh! That rainy night broke the roof and jammed middle D at the same time!
'Ah! Aquela noite chuvosa quebrou o telhado e emperrou o ré central ao mesmo tempo!'
Look at my aunt's note underneath: 'Locked Room Nine until the roof is dry.'
'Olhe a anotação da minha tia embaixo: "Quarto Nove trancado até que o telhado esteja seco."'
And she tucked her unfinished waltz inside the lid to wait for sunny weather!
'E ela guardou sua valsa inacabada dentro da tampa para esperar pelo tempo ensolarado!'
Then summer guests filled the house, years passed, and the bookcase went up.
'Então, os hóspedes de verão encheram a casa, anos se passaram, e a estante foi montada.'
She never got to hear the second half of her Friday waltz.
'Ela nunca conseguiu ouvir a segunda metade da sua valsa de sexta-feira.'
Arthur, with your permission, may I write the missing sixteen bars for Wednesday?
'Arthur, com sua permissão, posso escrever os dezesseis compassos que faltam para quarta-feira?'
You would finish my aunt's song for our reopening, Evelyn?!
'Você terminaria a música da minha tia para a nossa reabertura, Evelyn?!'
In the very same key, with her opening melody leading us home.
'Exatamente no mesmo tom, com sua melodia de abertura nos guiando de volta para casa.'
Agora vamos ouvir a conversa inteira uma última vez.
Look how neat every page is: date, room number, guest name, and weather.
Turn to May tenth, Evelyn—the Friday written on our postcard!
Here it is! 'Heavy rain all night; water dripped onto the sunroom piano.'
Read the next line: 'Moved the piano to the dry corner; middle key swollen shut.'
Oh! That rainy night broke the roof and jammed middle D at the same time!
Look at my aunt's note underneath: 'Locked Room Nine until the roof is dry.'
And she tucked her unfinished waltz inside the lid to wait for sunny weather!
Then summer guests filled the house, years passed, and the bookcase went up.
She never got to hear the second half of her Friday waltz.
Arthur, with your permission, may I write the missing sixteen bars for Wednesday?
You would finish my aunt's song for our reopening, Evelyn?!
In the very same key, with her opening melody leading us home.
O mistério da varanda trancada e da página inacabada está resolvido — e Evelyn se oferece para completar a valsa para a reabertura na quarta-feira.
See you next time.
